messages:
Anna: Hey team — quick sync. Product wants a single console panel for queue/batching health that combines runtime signals (batch size distribution, per-request queue wait) and infra signals (GPU saturation, queue depth) so SREs and PMs can spot regressions.
Miguel: +1. Can you list the specific metrics we need from runtime? :point_down: 
Anna: Runtime: batch_size_histogram (buckets up to 1024), request_queue_wait_ms{model,region,priority}, batch_emit_rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio. Infra: gpu_util_percent{instance_type}, worker_threads_free, inflight_requests, node_capacity
Sophia: Also add labels: model_version and deploy_tag so we can tie to rollouts. We'll need p50/p95/p99 for wait times.
Jamie: Agree. For alerts let's propose p95(request_queue_wait_ms) > 200ms for >5m OR inflight_requests / node_capacity > 0.85 for >3m.
Anna: Can infra emit node_capacity per node? If not, we'll compute from node metadata. Runtime team — can you expose queue depth and batch size histogram via Prom? Example minimal metric names:
```
batch_size_histogram{model="gpt-4x",region="us-west1"} 12345
request_queue_wait_ms_sum{...} 34567
request_queue_wait_ms_count{...} 789
```
Miguel: We can add those in the runtime exporter. Will include labels model, model_version, region, priority, deployment_tag. We won't expose raw node_capacity but will provide worker_threads_total and worker_threads_free.
Sophia: For dashboard UX — heatmap of batch_size distribution by model and a small sparkline for p95 wait by region. Also a saturation gauge per pool. Add a toggle to slice by deployment_tag (canary vs stable).
Anna: Nice. How about retention? We need 90d for alerting baselines and 7d for high-res (1s/5s). Is that feasible storage-wise? :money_with_wings: 
Miguel: 7d high-res okay for key metrics; histogram buckets at 1m rollup after 24h. We'll add a rollup plan to the RFC.
Jamie: Who's owning the Grafana/dashboard side? I can take a first pass if someone provides sample queries.
Anna: Jamie — please draft dashboards. Miguel/Sophia — provide PromQL snippets by EOD Friday. I'll create a ticket and include the product asks and the rollout tagging requirement. /cc @infra-bot for node-level metrics ingestion.
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4821: "Queue + Batch Health Dashboard" assigned to jamie, tags: monitoring, runtime. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INF-4821
Miguel: Putting a note — we should include a small synthetic load job to exercise batching shapes during rollout so we can verify canary doesn't spike p95 wait.
Sophia: Good idea. We can add a k8s job that sends varied sequence lengths.
Anna: Ok let's sync on Monday 10am to review dashboards. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
Jamie: +1. I'll post a screenshot mock in the channel before the meeting.
Anna: Thanks — closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
